Since 0.1.7. The major version stays 0.

### Start
A first run with no games asks Where are your games? Scan a code with your phone to sign in to RomM, or pick the folder that holds them (#372). Add a folder opens in a games folder Foldcade already saw, or at the top of internal storage (#386). Until a folder, a RomM server, or a ROM brings games in, Home ends on Add games. If Foldcade saw a ROM folder it cannot read yet, Find games leads (#372).

Settings › Library › Auto-find games looks for a ROMs or Emulation/roms folder on its own, including on an SD card. A folder it finds asks once to allow access (#366). A fresh install still asks once to be Home, because the Home button otherwise leaves Foldcade. With Moonlight or DroidDeck installed, that ask names them.

While Android's all-files page is open, the other screen says to tap the switch, then press Back. RetroArch's cores ask waits until Home has a game that needs one (#372). A missing core is fetched when that game starts (#364).

### Saves
PSP and GameCube saves sync before you play (#367). So do Dreamcast VMUs, and battery saves from the EX+ emulators (#370). A BIOS on RomM is placed by itself. Otherwise Foldcade names the file and the folder, and one pick lets it check and place your copy (#365).

On Set up saves, the clouds are the emulators that still need you. One no Home game plays on reads Not set up and sorts last. Find saves is now Auto-find saves. The save conflict sits on a card you press, and a copy names the save it keeps (#387).

B on a question a launch is waiting on closes it and leaves the game unstarted. Play without syncing is its own button (#381).

### Home
The name on the top screen follows the art, and a tile is cropped so its title stays in the picture. Play! is drawn as an Afterglow object. A collection is made when its name is saved, so Cancel leaves nothing behind (#388).

The game you are on keeps its art while other pictures load (#375, #383, #384). The art you picked stays sharp, and a wide picture uses the full width. Play totals stay in step (#376). Y's card, Find, and the grid's chrome are tidied (#379).

When B presses a button on a dialog, that button wears B. A dialog B only closes still says B Close or B Cancel. An empty collection has no Y menu (#391).

### RomM
Scan with your phone to sign in. The address is pasted on the phone, then you approve Foldcade on RomM. Typing on the Thor stays the other way (#374). A game keeps the name and cover Foldcade already has while RomM loads (#363, #385).

Started offline, a RomM game says No internet, with a Wi-Fi button. When RomM gives no code, the line reads Check the address, or scan to send it from your phone, and the button is Try again. On an empty library, the top screen shows the choice you are on (#391).

### Games
GameNative games come from Add to home screen, and from exported `.steam`, `.epic`, `.gog`, `.amazon`, and `.pcgame` files (#373).

A game still open comes back in its player instead of starting over (#368). Azahar's Both screens setup changes untouched options once, so a 3DS game can use each screen. Your own settings stay. Restore original puts the old config back (#371).

### Settings
Settings › Emulators and Settings › Library hold as many tiles as you have. The row slides to the one you are on (#369). The SteamGridDB form leads with a code, so a phone on this Wi-Fi can send the key (#369, #386).

Settings › Library says what each row is, and Add a folder is one press (#380). Settings stays where you left it when Android covers the page, and the other screen stays clear (#378, #382, #385).

The release asset is `foldcade.apk`.

### Known issues
- The Thor hardware checklist is open. A green emulator run is not a Thor pass. https://github.com/predmore/foldcade/issues/43
- GameNative's own library is not imported. Foldcade reads Home shortcuts and exported `.steam`, `.epic`, `.gog`, `.amazon`, and `.pcgame` files. It does not read GameNative's private database. https://github.com/predmore/foldcade/issues/100
- Android games launched from Foldcade don't record play history, so they don't appear in Recent or Most played.
